slides.title: The subjunctive; as if / as though
slides.subtitle: Formal requirements and unreal comparisons
goals: Use the **mandative subjunctive** after *suggest, insist, essential*.
Use **as if / as though** for appearances and unreal comparisons.

slides.title: Form and use

head: Structure
Example
rows: It is essential / vital that + base form
It looks **as if** it's going to rain.
He talks **as if** he **owned** the place.

slides.tip: The subjunctive uses the **base form** for all persons: *I suggest that she **go**.* British English often uses *should go*.

items.q: The committee proposed that the meeting ___ postponed.
She acts as if she ___ the boss. (she isn't)
It's vital that he ___ the truth.
